purpose: Teach: 同性愛/囚人/開戦/捕虜/硬化/反逆/窮地/救援

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、同性愛の社会的受容の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you took up the research on the social acceptance of homosexuality in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Composed teacher's opening, clear even pace, an encouraging lift on the tag question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、囚人の更生プログラムの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — and I also covered the research on rehabilitation programs for prisoners.
lines.style: Eager quick 'yes', then careful academic precision, a hint of pride quickening the pace.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、開戦に至るまでの外交史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you dealt with the diplomatic history leading up to the outbreak of war as well.
lines.style: Thoughtful slower delivery, weighing the heavy subject, steady approving undertone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、捕虜の処遇の国際法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the international-law research on the treatment of prisoners of war.
lines.style: Prompt and precise, slightly over-formal wording, earnest weight on the legal term.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、動脈硬化、つまり硬化症の医学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You even took on the medical research on arteriosclerosis — hardening of the arteries.
lines.style: Mild surprise coloring the praise, careful enunciation of the medical term, warm finish.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、歴史上の反逆罪の刑法的研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, and the criminal-law study of historical treason cases went into the paper too.
lines.style: Growing confidence, faster on a favorite subject, a small breath of enthusiasm at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、被災者の窮地からの脱出の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the sociology of how disaster victims escape truly desperate situations — you covered that as well.
lines.style: Gentler quieter register for the human subject, slowing with genuine respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、災害救援活動の実証研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the empirical research on disaster relief operations too.
lines.style: Satisfied final answer, steady and complete, quiet pride settling as he finishes.
